# Mongez

> A TypeScript ecosystem of 25 framework-agnostic packages — state, data fetching/caching, an event bus, a utility belt, i18n, DOM/SEO helpers, and AI-agent tooling. React adapters where relevant. Built for AI-assisted development.

## Packages

- [@mongez/events](https://mongez.js.org/events/llms.txt): A tiny, zero-dependency event bus with segment-aware namespace matching. Subscribe / trigger / unsubscribe with optional async dispatch and namespace-scoped cleanup. Used internally by `@mongez/atom` for atom lifecycle events; usable standalone for any pub/sub need.
- [@mongez/reinforcements](https://mongez.js.org/reinforcements/llms.txt): A typed, dependency-free TypeScript utility belt — ~130 functions for objects, strings, numbers, async, randomness, and functional composition. Tree-shakeable, zero runtime deps, 372 tests.
- [@mongez/supportive-is](https://mongez.js.org/supportive-is/llms.txt): Tree-shakable type & shape predicates: `isString`, `isEmpty`, `isUrl`, `isPromise`, `isMobile`, … Every check is its own named export so bundlers can drop what you don't use. Zero runtime dependencies. The legacy `Is` namespace (`Is.empty(value)`) is preserved as the default export.
- [@mongez/atom](https://mongez.js.org/atom/llms.txt): A framework-agnostic, action-shaped state primitive. Each atom is a typed value with action methods bound to it (`atom.update(...)`, `atom.merge(...)`, `atomCollection.push(...)`). Stores scope atoms to a request for SSR; Redux DevTools integration is opt-in.
- [@mongez/react-atom](https://mongez.js.org/react-atom/llms.txt): React adapter for `@mongez/atom`. Adds `useState` / `useValue` / `use(key)` / `useWatch` / `Provider` to every atom; ships an `AtomStoreProvider` for SSR scoping; includes hydration helpers and preset atoms for toggles, loading flags, fetch state, and modal portals.
- [@mongez/atomic-query](https://mongez.js.org/atomic-query/llms.txt): Client-only query cache for the `@mongez/atom` ecosystem. React-Query-style API: `useQuery`, `useMutation`, invalidate, refetch, optimistic updates. Built-in list helpers (push/unshift/remove/replace/sort/reverse). Hands SSR data fetching back to your framework's loader and seeds the cache via `<HydrateQueries>`.
- [@mongez/collection](https://mongez.js.org/collection/llms.txt): A chainable, immutable-by-default array wrapper. ~100 helpers — `where(...)`, `groupBy`, `sortBy`, `partition`, `chunk`, `pluck`, math/string transforms — over a single shared array reference, callable in a fluent pipeline. Despite the name, four methods leak in-place mutation (`sort`, `reverse`, `shift`, `pop`); see Mutation.
- [@mongez/cache](https://mongez.js.org/cache/llms.txt): A framework-agnostic cache facade with pluggable drivers — localStorage, sessionStorage, in-memory, and encrypted variants. One API, key prefixing, per-entry TTL, and a shape that drops into `@mongez/atom`'s `persist` slot.
- [@mongez/config](https://mongez.js.org/config/llms.txt): A tiny, framework-agnostic configuration tree. Drop a tree of values in once at boot; read them anywhere by dotted path with a default fallback. Four methods: `config.set`, `config.get`, `config.unset`, `config.list`. No dependencies beyond `@mongez/reinforcements`.
- [@mongez/dotenv](https://mongez.js.org/dotenv/llms.txt): A small `.env` loader for Node.js. Parses `KEY=VALUE` lines, coerces values to typed primitives (number, boolean, null), supports `${VAR}` interpolation, picks the right file based on `NODE_ENV`, and layers a `.env.shared` file of defaults underneath.
- [@mongez/encryption](https://mongez.js.org/encryption/llms.txt): Authenticated symmetric encryption for JSON-encodable values — WebCrypto AES-256-GCM under a PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 key, in one `await encrypt(value, key)` / `await decrypt(cipher, key)` pair — plus hex `md5`/`sha1`/`sha256`/`sha512` digests.
- [@mongez/concat-route](https://mongez.js.org/concat-route/llms.txt): A tiny, dependency-free path joiner. Concatenates any number of path segments into a single normalized leading-slash path. Handles stray slashes, falsy segments, and embedded `//`. One default export.
- [@mongez/query-string](https://mongez.js.org/query-string/llms.txt): Tiny query-string parse/serialize with nested-object and array support. Default-export object: `parse`, `toQueryString`, plus browser helpers `all`, `get`, `update`, `toString` that read/write `window.location`. No runtime dependencies.
- [@mongez/dom](https://mongez.js.org/dom/llms.txt): Browser-side DOM utilities. Flat, side-effect-free function exports for page metadata, fonts, stylesheets, CSS variables, keyboard helpers, viewport dimensions, and small DOM conveniences. No runtime dependencies.
- [@mongez/localization](https://mongez.js.org/localization/llms.txt): A framework-agnostic i18n primitive. Translation dictionaries, placeholder interpolation, count-based plural rules, locale-switching events, and a typed `transObject` proxy. The React adapter lives in [`@mongez/react-localization`](https://github.com/hassanzohdy/mongez-react-localization).
- [@mongez/react-localization](https://mongez.js.org/react-localization/llms.txt): React adapter for `@mongez/localization`. Adds a JSX-aware placeholder converter so `trans(...)` can interpolate React elements, plus `transX` — a JSX-bound `trans` variant that works regardless of which converter is configured globally.
- [@mongez/react-router](https://mongez.js.org/react-router/llms.txt): A configuration-based React router. Routes are registered as data on a singleton (`router.add("/users/:id", UserPage)`), then rendered through a single internal wrapper. First-class support for lazy-loaded apps/modules, locale-prefixed URLs (`/en/admin/users`), per-route middleware, prefetch-on-hover, and production chunk-error handling.
- [@mongez/react-helmet](https://mongez.js.org/react-helmet/llms.txt): React adapter for `@mongez/dom`'s metadata module. A single `<Helmet>` component sets the document title (with optional app-name suffix), description, keywords, Open Graph / Twitter meta, canonical URL, favicon, and `<html>` attributes — declarative, with cleanup on unmount.
- [@mongez/react-form](https://mongez.js.org/react-form/llms.txt): Headless React form handler for both Web and React Native. Provides a `Form` / `NativeForm` component plus a `useFormControl` hook that handles registration, async-capable validation, value collection, dirty/touched/disabled state, controlled and uncontrolled inputs, reactive hydration, Standard Schema interop, and a localized validation rule system.
- [@mongez/user](https://mongez.js.org/user/llms.txt): Framework-agnostic user/auth state manager — login, logout, access tokens, permissions, and pluggable persistence with an event bus.
- [@mongez/http](https://mongez.js.org/http/llms.txt): Robust native-fetch HTTP client for TypeScript. Returns `{data, error}` discriminated unions. Per-request `.cancel()`. Typed errors. Caching, retry, interceptors. `Resource` class for RESTful CRUD. SSR-safe by default, with `fetchInit` for Next.js `next: { revalidate, tags }`.
- [@mongez/vite](https://mongez.js.org/vite/llms.txt): A drop-in Vite plugin for SPA workflows. Loads the right `.env.<environment>` file via `@mongez/dotenv`, interpolates env values into `index.html`, mirrors tsconfig `paths` into `resolve.alias`, opens the browser during dev, sets `config.base` from env during build, zips the output dir after build, and optionally emits a SPA-friendly `.htaccess` + a `prerender.php` for crawler routing.
- [@mongez/pkgist](https://mongez.js.org/pkgist/llms.txt): A build, version, and publish tool for TypeScript/React npm packages. Dual ESM+CJS output via tsdown (Rolldown), standalone + family versioning, git tag+push automation, npm publish with registry read-back verification, bounded retries on network failures, per-phase failure reporting, dry-run mode, file cloning, source snapshots, and a `commit: true` shorthand for auto-generated `Released <version>` messages.
- [@mongez/copper](https://mongez.js.org/copper/llms.txt): Zero-dependency CLI toolkit: ANSI colors (20+ named hues across fg/bg/bright variants), spinners, progress bars, themed loggers, boxed messages, OSC-8 hyperlinks, and ANSI stripping. TypeScript-first, NO_COLOR / FORCE_COLOR aware, browser-safe imports.
- [@mongez/agent-kit](https://mongez.js.org/agent-kit/llms.txt): Authoring and distribution toolkit for AI coding agent artifacts. Treats `AGENTS.md` as a single source of truth and derives the tool-specific files each agent reads (`CLAUDE.md`, `.gemini/GEMINI.md`, `.github/copilot-instructions.md`, `CONVENTIONS.md`). Also syncs reusable skills bundled inside npm packages into per-agent skill directories with collision-free flat folder names.

## Full reference

- [llms-full.txt](https://mongez.js.org/llms-full.txt): every package's full reference concatenated into one file. One fetch wins when you want everything.
- Per-package full references: [/events/llms-full.txt](https://mongez.js.org/events/llms-full.txt) · [/reinforcements/llms-full.txt](https://mongez.js.org/reinforcements/llms-full.txt) · [/supportive-is/llms-full.txt](https://mongez.js.org/supportive-is/llms-full.txt) · [/atom/llms-full.txt](https://mongez.js.org/atom/llms-full.txt) · [/react-atom/llms-full.txt](https://mongez.js.org/react-atom/llms-full.txt) · [/atomic-query/llms-full.txt](https://mongez.js.org/atomic-query/llms-full.txt) · [/collection/llms-full.txt](https://mongez.js.org/collection/llms-full.txt) · [/cache/llms-full.txt](https://mongez.js.org/cache/llms-full.txt) · [/config/llms-full.txt](https://mongez.js.org/config/llms-full.txt) · [/dotenv/llms-full.txt](https://mongez.js.org/dotenv/llms-full.txt) · [/encryption/llms-full.txt](https://mongez.js.org/encryption/llms-full.txt) · [/concat-route/llms-full.txt](https://mongez.js.org/concat-route/llms-full.txt) · [/query-string/llms-full.txt](https://mongez.js.org/query-string/llms-full.txt) · [/dom/llms-full.txt](https://mongez.js.org/dom/llms-full.txt) · [/localization/llms-full.txt](https://mongez.js.org/localization/llms-full.txt) · [/react-localization/llms-full.txt](https://mongez.js.org/react-localization/llms-full.txt) · [/react-router/llms-full.txt](https://mongez.js.org/react-router/llms-full.txt) · [/react-helmet/llms-full.txt](https://mongez.js.org/react-helmet/llms-full.txt) · [/react-form/llms-full.txt](https://mongez.js.org/react-form/llms-full.txt) · [/user/llms-full.txt](https://mongez.js.org/user/llms-full.txt) · [/http/llms-full.txt](https://mongez.js.org/http/llms-full.txt) · [/vite/llms-full.txt](https://mongez.js.org/vite/llms-full.txt) · [/pkgist/llms-full.txt](https://mongez.js.org/pkgist/llms-full.txt) · [/copper/llms-full.txt](https://mongez.js.org/copper/llms-full.txt) · [/agent-kit/llms-full.txt](https://mongez.js.org/agent-kit/llms-full.txt)

## Docs

- [mongez.js.org](https://mongez.js.org): human-readable documentation site.
- [GitHub](https://github.com/hassanzohdy): source code per package.

## About the family

Every package ships zero-config TypeScript types, its own `llms.txt` / `llms-full.txt`, and a `skills/` folder of dense reference cards designed for LLM ingestion. The core packages are framework-agnostic; React adapters are provided where relevant. Install any package and point your coding agent at its `llms.txt`, or use [@mongez/agent-kit](https://mongez.js.org/agent-kit/overview/) to auto-discover and sync its skills into your agent.
